integrity: Original structural argument and exact formulas are accompanied by reproducible finite checks and explicit citations. No external independent scientific audit is asserted.

Classification of cover-number-three critical graphs could be known independently; bibliographic priority for the explicit polynomial and thresholds is not independently certified.

title: Minimal total domination of two-element Kneser graphs: four obstructions and two sharp coefficient transitions
